evidence.reason: DEPENDENCY_RE enumerates the [Unit] dependency directives the scanner rejects, but omits systemd v257's StopPropagatedFrom= and PropagatesStopTo=. A co-installed unit with StopPropagatedFrom=crq-tick.service is therefore not flagged, even though stopping crq-tick would stop that co-tenant. The scanner already covers analogous reverse stop coupling such as PartOf=, so this is an implementation gap in existing dependency discovery, not a new hardening requirement. Add both directives to the alternation.
